name: Ask agent polish: inline citations and feature cards
objective:
Fix two operator-reported defects on the AI 질문 surface. (1) Citation chips break the prose: InlineCitation's always-mounted .quoteWrap is display:grid — a block box in

's inline flow — so every chip forces a line break and a sentence resting on two or more 근거 renders as 「…입니다.[1] ⏎ [2] ⏎ [3]」. Re-cut the ask chip onto the conditionally-mounted absolute-popover anatomy components/Citation.tsx already ships (R10), so chips follow the sentence's period inline and adjacent chips sit side by side — across all three signed placements (프로즈 · 데이터 행 값 · 계산 입력), on the page and the widget, at desktop and ≤767. Server-side numbering is correct and is not touched. (2) The four hard-coded START_CHIPS_KO cards are all read-a-filing questions, exercising only search_events/get_event and leaving calculate, get_portfolio, save_feedback and get_contact invisible. Replace them with a card set — count freed from D11's 'exactly four' by operator instruction — chosen so that clicking the cards one at a time demonstrates every agent capability, keeping R16's layout and the 'card sentence is the question sent' rule. Lands before P4 so the demo video shows both.

review.note: operator-reported: (1) drop the 접수번호 get_event card and the 의견 save_feedback card — four cards remain; save_feedback undemonstrated is accepted, get_event still fires via the calculate card's 검색→이벤트 chain. (2) the company-bearing cards must be caught in real time rather than fixed, so they cannot go stale — server picks a live company per card shape at request time. (3) set the operator contact to leetusik@gmail.com · 010-3772-9916, and surface it in the footer on every page as well as in the agent's 연락처 answer.

acceptance.walkthrough:
RUNTIME: make stack-up, then http://127.0.0.1:3010 in Chrome (tailnet URL from make stack-status for a phone).

A (2 min) — /ask, press the FIRST card. The sentence's chips sit side by side after the period, same line, no break. Tap a chip: the quote floats over the text and nothing moves. Close by re-tap, Esc, or clicking away.

B (4 min) — 「새 대화」, then the cards one at a time. Four distinct 도구 행: 이벤트 검색 · 계산 (its trace walks 검색 → 이벤트 읽기 → 계산, which is where 이벤트 읽기 lives now) · 내 포트폴리오 읽기 · 운영자 연락처. THE FIRST TWO CARDS NAME A COMPANY CHOSEN WHEN THE PAGE LOADED — reload over the coming days and the names should follow the corpus, never a fixed pair. Check each answer is about that company. Card 2 marks 보유 주식수 「입력」 while the 배정비율 carries a 근거 chip; card 3 says 구성 예시.

C (1 min) — in card 2's answer tap the chip in the 공시에서 읽은 값 row and the one in the 계산 block: the quote opens under the row across the block, and the value column does not move.

D (2 min) — card 4 answers with your email and phone. Then look at the footer of /, /stocks, /portfolio and an event detail: the same two values close the identity row (email in the UI face, phone in mono, both tappable). /ops shows no footer by design.

E (1 min) — narrow the window to about 800px. Between roughly 481 and 840px the footer is now TWO rows where it was one (73px → 118-132px), because the identity line grew ~215px. Nothing overlaps or overflows and 의견 보내기 still hits. Accept, or ask for it back.

F (1 min) — on the landing, open the sparkle launcher, ask the same question, tap a chip: the quote must stay inside the widget.

REAL VS NOT: every answer is the live agent on real DART filings. NOTHING ON THE START SCREEN WRITES ANYTHING ANY MORE — the 의견 card is gone, so this walk leaves your review queue untouched.

DECISIONS TO TAKE:
(1) The quote panel's ground is opaque #0e1a15 instead of R16's translucent --surface-inset — the phase's one deliberate deviation, because as an overlay the translucent ground let the sentence read through your evidence. The 2px green edge and 180px cap are unchanged. Accept, or ask for it back.
(2) STILL OPEN FROM THE LAST GATE: the 767-and-below 인용 칩 target is 14 x 16 px, not the 44px R16 §2.6 lists. It never was, the round's own CSS never implemented it, and closing it means either a 44px box around a 10px number or a hit expander that makes each chip swallow its 3px-away neighbour. Close it (at which cost), or leave it?
(3) /ops/feedback holds EIGHT rows: ids 1-3 are genuine 2026-08-22 reader feedback; ids 4-8 all carry the 의견 card's sentence verbatim (4-6 from P11.S2, 7 from the first review, 8 from YOUR OWN gate walk). Clear ids 4-8 before the P4 demo, or keep them as evidence?
(4) NEW: your email and phone are now in the REPOSITORY as well as in the published product — a test pins them and the notebook records them. That follows from your instruction to publish them site-wide, but if you would rather the repo carried a fictional string it is a one-line change (filed as D33).

FRESH-EYES FINDINGS (reported, not fixed): the phone splits mid-number 「010-」/「3772-9916」 at 600-620px (D31); the identity row is a dense run of unlabeled values in two faces; the two 공시 cards name unfamiliar companies and change on reload (deliberate); the 계산 card wraps to two lines so the grid's rows are uneven; with the API down the landing / returns a 500 in English while /ask degrades gracefully, pre-existing (D32); one React #418 hydration mismatch fired once in ~20 production loads and was not reproducible in 11 further attempts (D34).
